outcome: ectopic pregnancy (incidence, risk factors, clinical presentation, management, immediate morbidity)
cohort: The study included patients presenting to the post graduate department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, S.M.G.S Hospital, GMC Jammu, India, from November 2021 to October 2022.
finding: The incidence of ectopic pregnancy was 1.4%, with the main risk factors identified as history of previous abortion, previous caesarean section, and pelvic inflammatory disease.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was identified as a risk factor for ectopic pregnancy.
